title: Automate changelog and onboard polaris-lite-4b v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
description: Motivation: add Polaris Lite 4b v1.0 to the model registry with curated performance profiles and wire it into automated changelog generation so new model onboards produce release notes automatically. This PR includes: - model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, recommended quantization profiles, recommended sequence lengths) - performance profiles for common workloads (chat, completions, embeddings) across GPU families - integration with the changelog generator so onboarding runs create consistent release notes entries - unit + e2e tests for the changelog generator and perf profile loader - small docs page + example onboarding script. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON - [x] Add perf profiles YAML - [x] Wire onboarding trigger into changelog generator - [x] Add CI jobs for model-registry integration - [x] Add tests and docs. Implementation notes: metadata lives under registry/onboard/polaris-lite-4b/v1.0/metadata.json; perf profiles are in registry/perf_profiles/polaris-lite-4b_v1.0.yaml; the changelog generator now accepts a --model-path flag and will append a canonical release note entry under docs/release-notes/models.md when run with CI credentials. The generator change is intentionally conservative: existing changelog format is preserved and entries are idempotent (script deduplicates by model name + version). Testing: added unit tests for the generator and an integration test that simulates an onboarding run and asserts a properly formatted changelog entry is produced. CI: model-registry workflow runs the new generator e2e and a lightweight perf-profile validation step that loads YAML and checks required keys. Backwards compatibility: metadata schema bump is additive; existing registries are unaffected. Rollout: after merge we'll run the onboarding runner (ops job) to publish the model and verify perf telemetry for the recommended profiles. Related: ENG-2384 tracks performance-profile validation work and PM-114 is the product ticket for the Polaris Lite onboard. See inline commit messages for smaller change breakdown.
